outcome: clinical outcomes of pregnancy in women with CKD requiring dialysis
cohort: 40 pregnancies in women with CKD who needed dialysis in pregnancy at a public hospital in Mexico City between 2002 and 2014.
finding: CKD requiring hemodialysis in pregnancy is associated with a high frequency of complications, and in the setting of delayed start and of thrice-weekly hemodialysis, dialysis schedules do not appear to influence outcomes.
